gates.text: Do not pause on "keep going", "going to bed, keep going", or "don't stop".
Own a clean checkpoint a cold-start agent can resume.
Finish the current atomic step or back it out, then cancel or pause exact owned nested work through supported native controls.
Confirm actual state; queued stop requests are not confirmed stops.
Take no irreversible action just to pause.
Do not create a PR or push a new branch.
Existing publication still needs its original authority.
Make a scoped WIP checkpoint of uncommitted task edits as one clear `wip:` commit on the current branch when commits are authorized.
If the tree is broken, say so in the commit body.
If commit authority or safety is missing, preserve unique edits and mark the WIP gate BLOCKED with the exact obstacle; do not silently omit the checkpoint or commit unrelated shared work.
Write an off-context cold-start resume note in a task-owned durable file.
Include intent, current atomic step, completed and verified work, disk and process state, exact branch and SHAs, next action, key files, and gotchas.
Point at an existing [show-me-your-work](workflows.md#show-me-your-work) trail instead of duplicating it.
Compaction notes must exist outside the shrinking conversation, not only in chat.
**Reply.** Position in the loop, what is on disk versus still unrecorded, checkpoint and note paths, commits, clean or dirty state, stop confirmation or blocker, and first resume action.
This is a pause, not a completion report.
